title: Dependency-aware task scheduler
prompt: A build scheduler runs tasks with dependencies. It currently starts dependents as soon as their parent is started, may run a shared dependency twice, and never rejects cycles. Fix schedule(tasks, runner) in scheduler.py. Run each task once only after all dependencies have succeeded; preserve declaration order among ready tasks; stop on the first runner failure; raise ValueError for unknown dependencies or cycles before running any task. Run visible tests and validate.
